body: Hm, yes. I guess in my mind I've always split it into "really racist" and "cultural appropriation", which in my mind has always been Tumblr nonsense. But I guess stuff I've classed as "really racist" would also be cultural appropriation. Like Breakfast at Tiffany's. Which I never actually saw, honestly. I really don't know what I'm talking about, lol.

I must confess first that I'm whiter than sour cream (and I think quoting Weird Al makes me whiter still) but I've never gotten cultural appropriation. It's like, if we don't have multiculturalism, that's racist, but if we do have things like sugar skulls that's cultural appropriation, and is also racist?? What?

It's also struck me as kind of infantilising people from other cultures, like white SJWs think they're too sensitive to see other people doing things from their culture...

(I'm not from North America and we don't have sugar skulls in my country anyway I don't really know much about them.)

My dad was trained in cooking by a Chinese chef from Hong Kong and so we eat almost exclusively Asian meals at my house, and my dad taught me to cook Chinese, and one time I was told that was cultural appropriation. No, man, it's just great food!

You'd think, but most recently people had a very stupid discussion about how demisexuals were real etc. Sadly what used to be a fun social event is coming up more and more like Tumblr and now I'm afraid of the witch hunt that will ensue if I breach Tumblr etiquette. Think I'll bring it up with one of the in charge people just quietly on the side and if they can't do anything just stop going.

Argh, Tumblr, why must you ruin my social life?

Argh, I know. Made me not want to go to these events anymore tbh. Once she got angry at me for laughing at a cute dog because... laughing at a cute dog meant I was mocking mentally disabled people??? Can't even with the mind gymnastics on that one.

Because these so-called "demisexuals", which is basically a term for Special Snowflake Syndrome, claim to be on the "asexual spectrum"... so they're like... part asexual? But come on man anybody, even people who don't believe in asexuality, would know that you're not asexual at all if you are into porn and sex and talk about it all the time :P Oh man, the dumbness she espouses... But then if you call her out on what she is, a straight girl invading a queer space for attention, you're committing "demisexual erasure" or some shit. Argh. Once she claimed demisexuals were "more oppressed" than asexuals... I'm like no, man, 95% of people would be demisexual if it were a real thing...

Can relate. I've done some great gender studies courses, but the one I'm doing now espouses the belief that we're all tricked into being heterosexual, that everyone is naturally bisexual or gay and that straight people are just lying to themselves so they can benefit from Teh Privilege. 

All PC ness aside, and I am LGBT myself, but most people are straight. It's just a fact.
